The TOC marker and doubled English name are not in 張亮，鄭州滎陽人, but the proposed after adds a copula and turns a literal name-plus-origin clause into a full sentence.
He was made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, then sent out as military governor of Luo.
He was appointed Chief Steward of the Household of the Heir Apparent, then sent out as military governor of Luo.
拜太子詹事 is the household steward of the heir-apparent (詹事), not Grand Mentor (太傅).
He was appointed Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, then sent out as military governor of Luo Prefecture.
He was appointed Chief Steward of the Household of the Heir Apparent, then sent out as military governor of Luo Prefecture.
The literal line makes the same 太子詹事 / 太傅 substitution; Chief Steward of the Household of the Heir Apparent is the office named.
__FORCETOC__Xue Wanjun was originally from Dunhuang and later moved to Xianyang in the capital district.
Xue Wanjun was originally from Dunhuang and later moved to Xianyang in the capital district.
The biographical sentence has no __FORCETOC__ marker; the prefix is not historical prose.
__FORCETOC__Xue Wanjun — Xue Wanjun, originally a man of Dunhuang, later moved to Xianyang in Jingzhao.
Xue Wanjun, originally a man of Dunhuang, later moved to Xianyang in Jingzhao.
__FORCETOC__ is interpolation; the doubled identical English name is not needed once the heading variant is read as the same 薛萬均.
When Yi submitted to Tang, Gaozu made Wanjun Supreme Pillar of State and Duke of Yong'an.
When he and Yi submitted, Gaozu made Wanjun Supreme Pillar of State and Duke of Yong'an.
與藝歸款 makes Wanjun a co-subject of the submission with Luo Yi; When Yi submitted drops 與.
He was appointed commander of the Left Unicorn Guard.
He was appointed general of the Left Garrison Guard.
左屯衛將軍 is the Left Garrison Guard; Unicorn Guard is not in the Chinese.
He was appointed Left Commander of the Unicorn Guard.
He was appointed General of the Left Garrison Guard.
屯衛 is the Garrison Guard, not Unicorn Guard, but Left General of the Garrison Guard scrambles 左屯衛將軍 as if Left modified General.
Later, when the emperor visited Furong Garden, he was imprisoned for impropriety in the Pure Palace and died of grief and resentment.
Later, when the emperor visited Furong Garden, Wanjun was imprisoned for negligence in clearing the palace and died of grief and resentment.
坐清宮不謹 is a charge of negligence in the pre-visit palace clearing, not impropriety inside a hall called the Pure Palace.
Later when the Emperor visited Furong Garden, he sat in the Pure Palace with impropriety and was cast into prison; distressed and resentful, he died.
Later when the Emperor visited Furong Garden, he was charged with negligence in clearing the palace and cast into prison; distressed and resentful, he died.
坐 is the legal charge, and 清宮 is the clearing of the palace, not sitting in a place named Pure Palace.
The enemy was terrified and withdrew to Bozhou.
The enemy was terrified; he then pressed upon Bozhuo city.
泊汋 is the city and 傅 is to press/invest it, not a withdrawal to Bozhou; the proposed after still makes 虜 the investors, though the next unit has Wanche drive off a relief force and take the city.
The barbarians were all shaken with terror and thereupon moored at Bozhou city.
The barbarians were all shaken with terror; thereupon he pressed upon Bozhuo city.
傅泊汋城 is not mooring at Bozhou, but the proposed after still lets 虜 govern 傅; the campaign subject who then 拔其城 is Wanche.
Appended: Lu Zushang — Lu Zushang, courtesy name Jiliang, was from Le'an in Guangzhou.
Appended: Lu Zushang — Lu Zushang, courtesy name Jiliang, was from Le'an in Guang Prefecture.
光州樂安 is Guang Prefecture, not the city Guangzhou (廣州).
On the Prince of Zhao's campaign against Fu Gongshi he served as vanguard, took Xuan and She, advanced against Feng Huiliang and Chen Zhengtong, and defeated them.

Following Xiaogong, Prince of Zhao Commandery, against Fu Gongshi, he served as vanguard commander, took Xuan and She, advanced against the rebel leaders Feng Huiliang and Chen Zhengtong, and defeated them.
The original drops 孝恭, shortens 前軍總管, and omits 郡 from 趙郡王; the proposal restores those but invents the surname Li, which the unit does not write.
Soon he led the Shandong route army with Prince Yong'an Xiaoji against Lü Chongmao at Xia; the army was beaten and he was taken.
Soon he led the east-of-Shan route army and followed Prince Yong'an Xiaoji against Lü Chongmao at Xia; the army was beaten and he was taken.
陝東道 is not Shandong, but the proposed after keeps with for 從 and inserts a Chinese parenthetical that the idiomatic line does not need.
Soon he also led the Shandong Route campaign command and followed Prince of Yong'an Xiaoji against Lü Chongmao at Xia county; the army was defeated and he was imprisoned by the rebels.
Soon he also led the east-of-Shan Route campaign command and followed Prince of Yong'an Xiaoji against Lü Chongmao at Xia county; the army was defeated and he was imprisoned by the rebels.
陝東道 is the circuit east of Shan, not Shandong; the literal replacement keeps 從 and only repairs the toponym.
When Shidu fell he was made prefect of Feng, then summoned as Right Commander of the Unicorn Guard.
When Shidu fell he was made prefect of Feng, then summoned as General of the Right Leading Army Guard.
右領軍衛將軍 is the Right Leading Army Guard, not an Unicorn Guard.
Earlier Xu Xuan of Changshe interpreted prophecy and told Lan, "Men say there is one who will live long as ruler — all say General Liu is destined for the throne."
Earlier Xu Xuan of Changshe interpreted the prophecy texts and told Lan, "The long-lived throughout the realm all say General Liu will become the ruler of the world."
天下有長年者，咸言劉將軍當為天下主 means the long-lived all say General Liu will be ruler; the original invents a separate long-lived sovereign.
